items.title: feat: agent-egress rules for metadata access, storage uploads and namespace escalation
items.body:
Adds detections for the agent behaviors described in #926.

New pack `agent-egress` (0.1.0, `defaultPolicy: block`):
- `cloud-metadata-access` (critical): a network use of 169.254.169.254, fd00:ec2::254, metadata.google.internal or 100.100.100.200. That means a URL in an executable field (WebFetch `url`), a network client in the command (curl, wget, nc, socat, httpie, PowerShell web requests), or an interpreter one-liner requesting it.
- `object-storage-file-upload` (critical): curl/wget sending a file (`-T`, `--upload-file`, `-d @file`, `-F x=@file`, `@-`), `$(env)` or `$(printenv)`, or wget `--post-file`/`--body-file`, to S3, Google Cloud Storage, Azure Blob, R2 or Alibaba OSS.
- `agent-probe-host` (critical): the two hosts named in the write-up, on a network use.
- `unshare-user-namespace` (high): `unshare` with `-U`, `-r`, `-c` (including clusters such as `-Urm`), `--user` or `--map-*-user`. Mount-only and network-only namespaces (`unshare -m`, `unshare --net`) are not flagged.

`command-risk` (0.2.0 to 0.3.0, default `warn`):
- `object-storage-upload`: curl/wget sending data to an object storage host.
- `alibaba-oss-host`: any other `oss-*.aliyuncs.com` host.
- `download-then-execute`: `curl -o`/`wget -O` to a path, then running that path (sh, bash, source, chmod +x, python, perl, node, or a direct run).
- `recon-then-egress`: recon (`cat /etc/resolv.conf`, `which … curl`, `ls -la /tmp`, `uname -a`, bare `id`/`hostname`) and a curl/wget/nc call in one command. Recon alone is silent.

Notes for review:
- A rule's action comes from its pack's `defaultPolicy`, so the four block-intended rules live in their own pack. An install that already has packs picks up `agent-egress` at `block` through `recordInventory` (covered by "a pack added beside unchanged ones still takes its defaultPolicyId"). The `command-risk` additions arrive as a normal pack update.
- `appliesTo` can't limit a rule to executable fields, so the `agent-egress` patterns require a network use. Searches (`grep`/`rg`), subagent prompts, and code or docs that merely mention an address stay silent. Each of these has a negative fixture.
- `feat/credential-read-guard` (#916) also bumps `command-risk` to 0.3.0. Whichever lands second needs 0.4.0 and a regenerated bundle; I'll rebase this one if #916 merges first.
- Known gaps: `curl -O` (file name taken from the URL) followed by a run isn't linked to the download, and an upload whose host is in a shell variable isn't matched. #924 covers the general case.

Checks: fixture tests for both packs, ReDoS and parse suites, the bundled-pack drift test and prettier pass locally. Typecheck, lint and test for detections, plugin-sdk and their dependents pass on a full run. Against the rebuilt Claude Code plugin, the 17 calls from the issue now give 14 deny and 3 silent (recon alone, which the transcript history still records as ordinary tool calls). A plain GitHub API call stays silent.

Closes #926

items.title: feat(core): enable the built-in web_search by default on ModelStudio Standard/Token Plan
items.body:
## What this PR does

The built-in `web_search` tool now turns itself on when the model you are already running can back the search request, instead of requiring three separate settings. Provider presets declare whether their endpoints serve DashScope's server-side search tools; Alibaba ModelStudio's Standard API Key and Token Plan presets declare that they do. When nothing under `tools.webSearch` is configured, the tool registry derives the search side channel from the entry backing the primary model — same endpoint, same key, searches billed to the account already in use. Entries that match no preset are accepted when their host is a DashScope endpoint, which covers hand-written `modelProviders` entries, custom-provider entries, and the workspace-specific Token Plan hosts that a preset's exact-URL match cannot recognize.

Explicit configuration is unchanged: a configured search model or an env-declared backend still resolves exactly as before, still reports a startup notice naming the missing piece when it cannot start, and still works for any DashScope-compatible entry regardless of which provider the main model uses. `enabled` becomes three-state — `false` turns the tool off, `true` keeps the old explicit behavior, and leaving it unset means "derive it". Automatic derivation never emits a startup notice: a user on a provider we cannot serve should not be warned about a feature they never asked for. Bare mode and safe mode now disable the tool explicitly rather than leaving it unconfigured.

Coding Plan is deliberately left out. Its endpoints have not been verified to serve the Responses API search tools, so its preset declares no backend and its hosts are excluded from the host fallback; Coding Plan users can still point the tool at any DashScope entry explicitly.

## Why it's needed

A ModelStudio user's primary `modelProviders` entry already satisfies every condition the tool checks — a DashScope-compatible HTTPS endpoint with a direct API key — yet the tool stayed off until they also set `enabled`, picked a search model, and learned that the model selector resolves like `fastModel`. Every comparable agent ships search on by default for accounts that can serve it, so the configuration burden fell only on our users, and the most common outcome was not "search off by choice" but "search missing without the user knowing it existed".

The safety properties that made opt-in the right call in #7215 are unchanged by this PR: search results still carry the untrusted-content footer, searches still bill the user's own key rather than a bundled service, and the tool still goes through the same approval path as every other tool — in `default` approval mode that means a confirmation dialog on the first search, and in Auto mode (the shipped default) the classifier approves searches without prompting, as it does for other read-only tools. What changes is only who has to type the configuration.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

```
cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/tools/web-search.test.ts src/config/config.test.ts src/providers
cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/config/config.test.ts
npm run lint && npm run typecheck
```

End to end, with a ModelStudio key in the environment and a `settings.json` that declares only a `modelProviders` entry (no `tools.webSearch` at all):

1. `qwen -p "What is the latest release of QwenLM/qwen-code on GitHub? Search the web." --approval-mode yolo --output-format stream-json` — `web_search` appears in the init tool list, one search runs, and the answer ends in a `Sources:` section.
2. Add `"tools": { "webSearch": { "enabled": false } }` — `web_search` is gone from the tool list and no warning is printed.
3. Point `settings.json` at a third-party provider instead (OpenRouter) — `web_search` is absent and startup prints no WebSearch notice.
4. `qwen --bare -p "..."` — `web_search` is absent.
5. In an interactive session started with `--approval-mode default`, ask a question that needs current information — the first search shows the confirmation dialog; choosing "always allow" persists a `WebSearch` rule in the project settings and later searches run without prompting. In Auto mode (the default) the classifier approves the search without a dialog.

### Evidence (Before & After)

**Before** (same build, this branch's `packages/` changes stashed; `settings.json` declares only a Token Plan `modelProviders` entry and no `tools.webSearch`):

```
$ qwen -p "What is the latest release of QwenLM/qwen-code on GitHub? Search the web." --approval-mode yolo --output-format stream-json
{"type":"system","subtype":"init","tools":["get_goal","update_goal","tool_search","read_mcp_resource","agent",...]}
... "tool_use","name":"web_fetch"
The latest release of **QwenLM/qwen-code** is **v0.23.1-preview.2**, released on September 7, 2026.
```

`web_search` is absent from the tool list, so the model falls back to fetching a URL it guessed, and the answer carries no `Sources:` section.

**After** (same settings, unchanged):

```
$ qwen -p "What is the latest release of QwenLM/qwen-code on GitHub? Search the web." --approval-mode yolo --output-format stream-json
{"type":"system","subtype":"init","tools":["web_search","get_goal","update_goal",...],"model":"qwen3.6-plus"}
... "tool_use","name":"web_search","input":{"query":"QwenLM/qwen-code latest release GitHub 2026"}
... "tool_result": Did 1 search in 35.6s
The latest release of **QwenLM/qwen-code** on GitHub is **v0.23.1-preview.2**, as of September 2026.

Sources:
- [GitHub releases page for QwenLM/qwen-code](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/releases)
- [QwenLM/qwen-code repository](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code)
```

The other four checks on the same build (the env-only row was re-measured in an isolated `HOME` after the follow-up commit that reads the resolved generation config instead of the not-yet-captured runtime snapshot; it runs a real search and answers with `Sources:` too):

| Configuration                                             | `web_search` in the init tool list | WebSearch startup notice |
| --------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------- | ------------------------ |
| Token Plan entry, no `tools.webSearch`                    | yes                                | none                     |
| Same plus `"webSearch": { "enabled": false }`             | no                                 | none                     |
| OpenRouter entry only                                     | no                                 | none                     |
| `--bare`                                                  | no                                 | none                     |
| Env-only (`OPENAI_BASE_URL` at a DashScope host, no entry, isolated `HOME`) | yes                                | none                     |

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Linux, local build from this branch, real ModelStudio Token Plan endpoint.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: ModelStudio users who never configured web search will now have the model search on their behalf, billed to their key. In the shipped Auto approval mode this happens without a confirmation dialog, like other read-only tools; `default` approval mode asks the first time. The tool is off with `"tools": { "webSearch": { "enabled": false } }` or `ENABLE_WEB_SEARCH=false`, and reverting the change is a one-line condition in the registry.
- Not validated / out of scope: Coding Plan endpoints are not probed, so they keep the old explicit-configuration behavior. Providers other than DashScope-compatible ones gain nothing here — backends for their native search tools are separate work. Result formatting, session budgets, and source titles are untouched.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none for anyone with an explicit configuration. Users on ModelStudio with no configuration gain the tool; the docs say how to turn it off.

## Linked Issues

Related to #7215, #3502

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的内容

内置 `web_search` 现在会在当前主模型所在的接入方式本身就能承载搜索请求时自动开启，不再需要用户配置三项设置。供应商预设新增一个字段，声明其端点是否提供 DashScope 服务端搜索工具；阿里云百炼 ModelStudio 的 Standard API Key 与 Token Plan 两个预设声明支持。当 `tools.webSearch` 下没有任何配置时，工具注册表会从承载主模型的那条条目推导出搜索侧通道，端点与 key 都复用主模型的，费用记在用户已经在用的账号上。匹配不到任何预设的条目，只要 host 是 DashScope 端点也会被接受，覆盖手写的 `modelProviders` 条目、自定义供应商条目，以及预设的精确 URL 匹配识别不出的 Token Plan 工作空间专属 host。

显式配置的行为完全不变：配置了搜索模型或 env 声明的后端时，解析路径、失败时指明缺失项的启动提示、以及"主模型可以是任意供应商、只要搜索侧是 DashScope 条目"这一点都与之前一致。`enabled` 变为三态：`false` 关闭，`true` 保持原有的显式行为，不设置则表示"自动推导"。自动推导失败时不产生任何启动提示，因为不该为用户从未配置过的功能发出警告。bare 模式与 safe 模式现在显式关闭该工具，而不是留空。

Coding Plan 有意不纳入。其端点是否提供 Responses API 搜索工具尚未验证，因此其预设不声明后端，其 host 也被排除在兜底判定之外；Coding Plan 用户仍可显式把工具指向任意 DashScope 条目。

## 为什么需要

ModelStudio 用户的主 `modelProviders` 条目本身就满足工具检查的全部条件——带直接 API key 的 DashScope 兼容 HTTPS 端点——但工具仍然保持关闭，直到用户额外设置 `enabled`、挑一个搜索模型，并弄清楚模型选择器的解析方式与 `fastModel` 相同。同类的编码代理对能够提供搜索的账号都默认开启，于是配置负担只落在我们的用户身上，而最常见的结果并不是"用户主动选择不用搜索"，而是"用户不知道有这个功能，搜索一直缺席"。

#7215 当时选择 opt-in 所依据的安全性质，本 PR 一项都没有改变：结果仍带不可信内容的安全脚注；搜索仍然计费在用户自己的 key 上，而不是我们捆绑的服务；工具仍走与其他工具相同的审批路径——`default` 审批模式下首次搜索弹确认框，而 Auto 模式（发布默认值）下由分类器直接放行，与其他只读工具一致。改变的只是由谁来敲这份配置。

## 评审验证方式

```
cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/tools/web-search.test.ts src/config/config.test.ts src/providers
cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/config/config.test.ts
npm run lint && npm run typecheck
```

端到端：环境里有 ModelStudio key，`settings.json` 只声明一条 `modelProviders` 条目（完全没有 `tools.webSearch`）：

1. `qwen -p "What is the latest release of QwenLM/qwen-code on GitHub? Search the web." --approval-mode yolo --output-format stream-json` —— init 的工具列表里出现 `web_search`，执行一次搜索，回答末尾带 `Sources:` 段。
2. 加上 `"tools": { "webSearch": { "enabled": false } }` —— 工具列表里没有 `web_search`，也不打印任何警告。
3. 把 `settings.json` 换成第三方供应商（OpenRouter）—— 没有 `web_search`，启动也没有 WebSearch 提示。
4. `qwen --bare -p "..."` —— 没有 `web_search`。
5. 用 `--approval-mode default` 启动交互会话，问一个需要最新信息的问题 —— 第一次搜索弹出确认框；选择 "always allow" 后在项目设置里持久化一条 `WebSearch` 规则，后续搜索不再询问。Auto 模式（默认）下由分类器放行，不弹框。

### 证据（Before & After）

见上方英文部分的 Before & After 记录：同一份只声明 Token Plan 条目、没有任何 `tools.webSearch` 的 `settings.json`，改动前 init 工具列表里没有 `web_search`，改动后出现该工具、执行了一次真实搜索、回答末尾带 `Sources:` 段；另外四种配置（显式关闭、第三方供应商、bare 模式、env-only）的结果见同一张表。

### 测试平台

Linux ✅，macOS 与 Windows 未测试。

### 运行环境（可选）

Linux，本分支本地构建，真实的 ModelStudio Token Plan 端点。

## 风险与影响范围

- 主要风险或取舍：从未配置过 web search 的 ModelStudio 用户，模型会替他们发起搜索并计费在他们的 key 上。发布默认的 Auto 审批模式下不弹确认框（与其他只读工具一致），`default` 审批模式下首次会问。用 `"tools": { "webSearch": { "enabled": false } }` 或 `ENABLE_WEB_SEARCH=false` 即可关闭，回滚只需改注册表里的一行条件。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：Coding Plan 端点未做探测，保持原有的显式配置行为。DashScope 兼容之外的供应商在本 PR 中没有变化——接入它们各自的原生搜索工具是后续工作。结果格式、会话预算、来源标题都未改动。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：对任何有显式配置的用户都没有变化。使用 ModelStudio 且没有配置的用户会获得该工具；文档中说明了如何关闭。

## 关联 Issue

Related to #7215, #3502

</details>

items.title: feat(providers): show newest discovered models first
items.body:
## What this PR does

This presents a successfully discovered provider catalog as one unified model list instead of splitting built-in and provider-only entries into Recommended and Other sections. When every returned entry has a valid non-negative `created` timestamp, the catalog is sorted newest first while equal timestamps retain provider order. If creation metadata is incomplete or invalid, the provider's original order is preserved. Known models still receive curated capability metadata, and existing selection behavior is unchanged.

## Why it's needed

The previous built-in-first grouping could push newly released provider models below the eight-row viewport and make a live catalog look stale. A single recency-ordered list makes the latest available models visible immediately without guessing release dates from model names or automatically selecting newly discovered entries.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Open `/auth`, choose Alibaba ModelStudio and Token Plan, enter a valid key, and continue to Model IDs. After the loading state, expect one `Models · from the provider` section with no Other subsection. With the current Beijing catalog, expect `qwen3.8-flash` before `qwen3.8-max`. Confirm search, toggling, and submission still work, provider-only models remain unchecked by default, and an unavailable catalog still falls back to the built-in recommendations.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before:

```text
Recommended models · from the provider
qwen3.7-plus
...
Other models from the provider
wan2.7-image
```

After:

```text
Models · from the provider
qwen3.8-flash
qwen-audio-3.0-realtime-plus
qwen3.8-max
...
```

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

macOS with Node.js 24.14.1. Verified against the authenticated Beijing Token Plan catalog, rendered Ink component tests, focused model-discovery tests, the full workspace build and typecheck, and focused ESLint.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: `created` represents catalog creation time rather than last update time; it is used only when every returned model supplies a valid value.
- Not validated / out of scope: provider pagination and automatically selecting newly discovered models are unchanged; Windows and Linux were not tested locally.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Persisted provider settings are unchanged.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #9980.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

成功动态发现模型目录后，配置向导现在使用一个统一列表展示所有模型，不再把内置模型和仅由服务端返回的模型拆成 Recommended 与 Other 两个分区。当所有返回项都包含有效的非负 `created` 时间戳时，目录按时间从新到旧排序；时间相同的模型保持服务端原顺序。如果时间信息不完整或无效，则完整保留服务端原顺序。已知模型仍会补充人工维护的能力元数据，现有勾选行为保持不变。

## 为什么需要

此前的内置模型优先分组会把新发布的服务端模型挤到八行可视区域之外，让实时目录看起来像旧静态列表。统一并按时间排序后，最新可用模型会直接显示在前面，同时不会根据模型名猜测发布日期，也不会自动勾选新发现的模型。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

打开 `/auth`，依次选择 Alibaba ModelStudio 和 Token Plan，输入有效 key 后进入 Model IDs。加载完成后应只显示一个 `Models · from the provider` 分区，不再出现 Other 子分区。使用当前北京目录时，`qwen3.8-flash` 应排在 `qwen3.8-max` 前面。继续确认搜索、勾选和提交仍正常，仅由服务端返回的模型默认不勾选，目录不可用时仍回退到内置推荐列表。

### 证据（Before & After）

之前：

```text
Recommended models · from the provider
qwen3.7-plus
...
Other models from the provider
wan2.7-image
```

之后：

```text
Models · from the provider
qwen3.8-flash
qwen-audio-3.0-realtime-plus
qwen3.8-max
...
```

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境（可选）

macOS、Node.js 24.14.1。已通过带认证的北京 Token Plan 目录、Ink 组件渲染测试、模型发现聚焦测试、完整 workspace build 与 typecheck，以及聚焦 ESLint 验证。

## 风险与范围

## Goal
在现有 `run_turn`、`CodingTaskRunner`、CLI / Pi TUI 上验证 **一个真正可用的 Agent**，而不是再加新抽象。来源：已归档 [Roadmap V4](https://github.com/CaiusLuo/cairn/issues/24#issuecomment-6170192216)。

## Small slice
1. 准备**一次性的本地 Git fixture**：一个单文件/小模块的真实可验证修复，提供明确输入、预期 Diff、离线检查（不可只用模型声称成功）。执行前后独立核对 HEAD/index/source 原始仓库不变，Agent 工作区可审计。
2. 为该场景提供离线 scripted provider 集成检查：模型→read/edit/bash→权限→完整响应→确定性验证；记录取消/失败至少各 1 个负面路径。不重写现有 EvalSuite。
3. **单独的人工授权阶段**：用户明确批准 provider、token/费用上限后，运行一次真实模型 Coding Task（本地即可，不发布），记录真实结果、总耗时、可得 tokens/成本、trace、Diff 和检查输出。未授权时报告 `LIVE_BLOCKED`，**不能把 fake 结果算作真实验收**。
4. 用一次真实观察总结最多 3 个经复现的工程/UX 缺陷；不要未经确认顺便大重构。

## Acceptance
- [ ] 离线 E2E 能重复验证最终文件状态，包含权限、失败/取消路径。
- [ ] 报告 baseline SHA、Task/Session/Trace ID（有则提供）、工具调用、检查 verdict、成本（不可得标 unknown）。
- [ ] 真人授权的真实 provider 路径明确 PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED，失败提供可复现实据。
- [ ] 工作树隔离、Secret 不出现在报告/Trace，主线行为不受影响。

## Out of scope
自动 PR、长时后台服务、Queue/DAG、改变模型权限；不自动触发付费 API。

## Delivery
独立分支和聚焦 commit；遵循 AGENTS.md，专项测试+必要 CI，交付 review SHA。**本 Issue 的离线实现可先完成，真实测试缺授权必须保留明确 BLOCKED。**

# SPEC 收据

来源文件：
- `C:\Users\will\Downloads\WAG 中文优先搜索供给增强 SPEC.md`
- `C:\Users\will\Downloads\订阅清单 v0.md`

本 issue 是 WAG 中文优先搜索供给增强的 GitHub SPEC 真源。范围包括 P0 出口/引擎只读诊断与受控修复、P1 官方 API 适配层、P2 中文来源/日期验证、P3 本地索引；不新增 MCP 工具，不改共享 sing-box/代理，不做验证码破解，不降低验收标准。

已确认约束：小电脑大陆家庭宽带；付费 API 月预算硬上限 ¥10；凭证由用户管理，禁止进入仓库。人工门槛：订阅清单 v0 需用户删改后定稿；P0 基线后阈值需用户确认并冻结；真实 API 接入需要用户先提供/配置凭证。未越过这些门槛前，只做不需凭证、不改生产的读取、设计、测试和适配器契约工作。

工作流留痕：本 SPEC 在实现前登记；后续 Kanban 卡、实现、测试、独立验收、合并/部署结果均回填本 issue。#49/#60/#74 作为供给残余子问题继续关联，不重复关闭或伪造通过。

---

# WAG 中文优先搜索供给增强 SPEC

Oct 13, 2026 · @yosef nani

## 背景与问题

WAG 的代码与部署已完成（生产版本 `runtime-_w7o12mz`，release 测试 14/14 通过），剩下的是搜索供给不足。最新 120 次只读配对测试中，strict day 零结果率 100%，多引擎同时出结果 0%。

| 查询类型 | 不加引擎池 | 加当前引擎池 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| general 零结果率 | 90% | 85% |
| news 零结果率 | 100% | 70% |
| strict day 零结果率 | 100% | 100% |
| ≥ 2 个引擎同时出结果 | 0% | 0% |

根因判断：所有结果都来自同一条通道，即从同一个出口抓取公共搜索引擎网页。这条通道天然受验证码和限流影响，也不提供可验证的发布时间。在 quark、yandex、bing、chinaso news 之间调整引擎池，改变不了这个结构。

三个需要优先排除的疑点：

- 零结果率极高，且多引擎从不同时成功，更像共同原因（出口 IP 信誉、SearXNG 解析器过期、超时配置），而不是四个引擎各自独立故障。
- quark、chinaso 是国内引擎，若经海外 sing-box 出口访问，触发验证码的阈值很低。
- 评测本身约 240 次请求集中打在同一出口上，可能参与触发了验证码。

## 目标、非目标与范围

本 SPEC 让 `web_search` 以中文和中国大陆信息为主：稳定召回、覆盖平台内容，并为 strict 时间窗提供页面级日期证据。海外搜索作为补充。

**目标**

- 中文 general 与 news 查询的零结果率显著下降，且至少两个独立来源能同时出结果。
- strict day 查询有可用结果，且每条结果都带页面级日期证据。
- 覆盖通用搜索引擎搜不到的平台内容，首先是微信公众号。
- 每个供给源的健康状况可观测，熔断和降级基于真实数据。

**非目标**

- 不新增 MCP 工具，能力继续整合在现有 `web_search` / `web_read` 中。
- 不修改共享代理或 sing-box 节点。
- 不降低验收标准；可用性、供给、相关性、日期证据继续分开报告。
- 小红书、抖音暂不纳入验收范围，目前没有稳定、合规的检索路径。
- 不做验证码自动破解。

**范围**：中文为主、海外为辅。评测查询集中，中文约占 70%。具体阈值见「评测、监控与验收」。

**约束（已确认）**：付费 API 月预算硬上限 ¥10（约 $1）；小电脑接在大陆家庭宽带上；API 凭证由用户自行管理。

## 关键定义

strict 模式的语义从「引擎声称在时间窗内」改为「页面证据证明在时间窗内」。这比现状更严，不是放宽验收标准。

**日期证据等级**（从强到弱）

| 等级 | 来源 | 能否单独满足 strict |
| --- | --- | --- |
| E1 页面结构化数据 | JSON-LD `datePublished`、`article:published_time` 等 meta | 能 |
| E2 页面正文 | 「发布时间：…」「2026年10月13日 来源：…」等，经站点规则或中文正则提取 | 能 |
| E3 URL 或 sitemap | URL 中的日期段、sitemap 的 `lastmod` | 不能，只作辅助，且不得与 E1/E2 冲突 |
| E4 来源声明 | 搜索引擎或 API 返回的 `publishedDate`、`publishedTime`、`datePublished` | 不能，只用于预筛和排序 |
| E5 无证据 | — | 不能 |

**结果状态**

- `verified`：有 E1 或 E2 证据，且日期落在时间窗内。
- `claimed`：只有 E4，未经页面验证。strict 模式下不计入合格结果，但保留在诊断字段中。
- `unknown`：没有任何日期证据。
- `out_of_window`：有证据但不在时间窗内，strict 模式下剔除。

**原发与转载**：转载页的日期不等于原发日期。转载聚类后，strict 判断以簇内最早的已验证日期为准，并标出原发来源。

**来源分级**（用于排序和展示，不用于过滤）

| 级别 | 示例 |
| --- | --- |
| T1 官方 | gov.cn、各部委与地方政府网站、监管机构、上市公司公告 |
| T2 央媒与通讯社 | 新华社、人民日报、央视 |
| T3 市场化媒体 | 财新、澎湃、界面 |
| T4 平台自媒体 | 公众号、百家号、企鹅号、头条号、知乎 |
| T5 聚合站与内容农场 | 搬运站、SEO 站 |

## 总体架构

查询先经查询处理与意图路由，再由中文免费层召回；免费层不足时才调用国内官方 API，海外通道作补充。所有来源的结果走同一条融合、去重与日期验证链。

[embedded content: 分层供给架构 · 三类来源，一条融合与验证链\]

strict 模式下，只有通过页面级日期验证的结果会被返回；非 strict 模式不等待验证，只在诊断字段中标出状态。

## P0：出口分流与引擎修复

P0 只改 WAG 自己的 SearXNG overlay，不碰共享代理，目的是先排除「出口和配置」这个共同原因。

1. **出口对照实验**：同一批中文查询分别从大陆直连和代理出口发出，记录各引擎的成功率、验证码率和延迟，分清是引擎问题还是 IP 问题。
2. **按引擎分流**：SearXNG 的 settings.yml 支持为单个引擎设置 `proxies` 和 `timeout`（[文档](https://docs.searxng.org/dev/engines/engine_overview.html)）。国内引擎（quark、chinaso 及新增中文引擎）直连；bing、yandex 等海外引擎走代理，各自设置合理超时。
3. **升级 SearXNG**：引擎改版后，旧解析器会静默返回空结果。升级到最新稳定版后复测。
4. **扩充中文引擎**：评估新版 SearXNG 中的百度、搜狗、360 等中文适配器（以部署版本为准），通过对照实验的才启用。
5. **降频**：为每个引擎设置请求速率上限；评测脚本降频、错峰，避免评测本身触发验证码。

**前提（已确认）**：小电脑接在大陆家庭宽带上，国内引擎直连可行，P0 是收益最高、成本为零的一步。

**家宽保护**：这个 IP 同时是家里日常上网的出口，被搜索引擎风控会影响家人正常使用百度等网站，所以限流比机房环境更重要。

- 初始限速：每个引擎每分钟不超过 6 次，所有国内引擎合计每分钟不超过 30 次，再按验证码率调整。
- 验证码熔断：检测到验证码页面即暂停该引擎 30 分钟，连续触发时按指数退避。
- 评测与 canary 也计入同一限速，不单独放行。
- 家宽 IP 可能变化：限速和熔断按引擎计数，不绑定具体 IP。

**交付物**：出口对照实验报告、分流后的 overlay 配置、P0 基线评测结果。

## P1：国内官方 API 兜底层

P1 接入百度千帆、阿里云 IQS、腾讯云元宝搜索（WSA）三家官方搜索 API 作为兜底层，月预算硬上限 ¥10。百度的每日免费额度承担主要兜底，两家付费 API 只用在各自独有的价值上。

| 服务 | 中文场景的价值 | 时间能力 | 按量单价 | 本 SPEC 中的角色 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [百度千帆 百度搜索](https://ai.baidu.com/ai-doc/AppBuilder/pmaxd1hvy) | 中文最大的索引；可限定或屏蔽站点 | 内置周/月/半年/年，可用固定日期或相对表达式指定精确范围 | 每天 100 次免费，每账号每天上限 10 万次 | 主兜底，只用免费额度 |
| [阿里云 IQS 联网搜索](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2987411.html) | 独立索引；可按中央/省级新闻分类限定站点；可返回网页正文 | `timeRange` 支持 OneDay，返回 `publishedTime`（新引擎类型的参数支持以接入时文档为准） | 国内版 LiteBasic ¥8/千次，Auto ¥18/千次 | strict 补充召回，每月 ≤ ¥5 |
| [腾讯云 元宝搜索（WSA）](https://cloud.tencent.com/document/product/1806/121794) | 来源为搜狗；覆盖企鹅号、腾讯新闻；可限定站点 | 支持指定时间范围；日期字段可能为空 | 极速版 ¥14/千次，标准版 ¥20/千次 | 公众号通道专用，每月 ≤ ¥5 |
| [博查](https://docs.console.zenlayer.com/api/cn/compute/mcpg/web-search/bochaai)（备选） | 独立 AI 搜索服务；可限定站点 | `freshness` 支持 oneDay 和自定义区间，返回 `datePublished` | 以官网为准 | 暂不接入 |

价格来源：[腾讯云元宝搜索计费概述](https://cloud.tencent.com/document/product/1806/121798)、[阿里云 IQS 联网搜索计费说明](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/document_detail/2862023.html)，2026-10-13 查阅。两家都是按量后付费、按日结算，文档中未见免费额度。

**路由规则**

1. 先跑免费层：SearXNG 国内引擎、本地中文新闻索引。
2. 免费层零结果，或 strict 模式下 verified 结果少于 3 条，才调用百度（只在每日免费额度内）。
3. 调用百度后，strict 模式仍少于 3 条 verified，才调用阿里云 IQS。
4. 查询带公众号意图（含「公众号」「微信文章」，或调用方指定）时，调用腾讯云元宝搜索，站点限定 `mp.weixin.qq.com`。
5. 按顺序调用，不并发。任一 provider 达到日或月上限即跳过，并在诊断字段标明 `budget_exhausted`。
6. API 返回的日期一律按 E4 处理，必须经 P2 的页面级验证才能标为 `verified`。博查官方也说明，指定时间范围可能导致无结果，所以时间过滤只作召回参数，不作结论。

**预算分配（每月 ¥10 硬上限）**

| Provider | 月上限 | 约合调用次数 | 日上限 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 百度千帆 | ¥0，只用免费额度 | 约 3,000 次 | 100 次 |
| 阿里云 IQS（国内版 LiteBasic） | ¥5 | 约 625 次 | 20 次 |
| 腾讯云元宝搜索（极速版） | ¥5 | 约 357 次 | 12 次 |
| Brave（海外） | $0，只用每月赠送额度 | ≤ 900 次 | 30 次 |

- 硬上限在 WAG 内执行：按 provider 记录日/月调用次数，调用前检查，不依赖云账单回传。
- 第二道防线：百度不开通后付费；阿里云、腾讯云在各自费用中心设置费用预警。
- 日上限防止某一天把整月额度用完。
- 每月初按上月日志，在阿里云和腾讯云之间重新分配 ¥10，总额不变。

**工程要求**

- 每家 API 一个 adapter，统一输出 `title`、`url`、`snippet`、`source`、`claimed_date`、`provider`。
- 查询缓存：以规范化查询 + 模式 + 时间窗为键。预算极低，所以缓存时间加长：general 24 小时，news 2 小时，strict day 60 分钟。
- 预算控制：见上表，超限自动降级到免费层。
- 凭证由用户在小电脑上自行管理（环境变量或密钥文件），WAG 只读取，不进仓库。
- adapter 契约测试纳入 release 测试。

**交付物**：三个 adapter、路由与缓存、预算控制、P1 评测结果。

## P2：围墙花园通道与中文日期验证

P2 补两块：通用引擎搜不到的平台内容，以及适配中文页面的日期验证管线。后者是 strict day 的根本解法。

### 公众号通道

- 微信文章在百度上搜不到（[来源](https://blog.sinorbis.com/china-search-engine-marketing)），搜狗是唯一能检索微信内容的搜索引擎（[来源](https://www.chinainternetwatch.com/tag/sogou)）。
- 直接抓取 wx.sogou.com 反爬很重，不作为主路径。
- 主路径：用腾讯云 WSA 把站点限定为 `mp.weixin.qq.com`，再加最近 N 天过滤（[已有类似封装](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/lyqi712/yan/tools/search_wechat_articles_tencent)）。
- 公众号文章页需要单独的日期提取规则，发布时间常在页面脚本中，需实测确认。

### 其他平台

- 头条、知乎、B 站、微博：自建 RSSHub，订阅关心的账号、话题和热榜，由 Task Center 定时拉取，进入 P3 的本地索引。
- 政策与官方信息：gov.cn 与各部委官网（RSSHub 或 sitemap），配合 IQS 的中央/省级新闻分类。
- 小红书、抖音：暂不纳入。

### 中文页面级日期验证

流程：召回候选 → 并发抓取前 10–20 条 → 按证据等级提取日期 → 判定状态 → 过滤与排序。

1. **E1**：JSON-LD、`article:published_time`、`pubdate` 等 meta。
2. **E2**：对最常用的 50 个中文域名写站点规则；其余用中文正则，匹配「发布时间：」「发布日期：」「YYYY年MM月DD日」，以及紧邻「来源：」的「YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM」。
3. **E3**：URL 日期段、sitemap `lastmod`。国内站点为百度收录普遍提供 sitemap。
4. htmldate 这类通用库只作最后兜底。它偏欧美页面，不能单独依赖。

**噪声排除**：侧栏、「今日」栏目、页脚版权年份、评论时间、相关推荐列表中的日期。

**复用**：扩展现有「新闻页面发布者日期提取」模块的中文规则，不重写；抓取复用 Crawl4AI 与 Playwright。

**性能**：设置抓取并发上限与超时；按 URL 缓存验证结果（建议 7 天）；非 strict 查询不等待验证。

**交付物**：公众号通道、RSSHub 部署与首批订阅、中文日期规则、约 200 页的日期标注集。

## P3：自建中文新闻索引与结果质量

P3 让已订阅来源上的 strict day 查询不再依赖任何外部搜索引擎：时效查询变成本地查询，日期在入库时就已验证。

### 自建索引

- **来源**：100–300 个关心的中文媒体与官方站点，加上 P2 的 RSSHub 路由。
- **获取**：RSS、RSSHub、sitemap。
- **调度**：由 Task Center 每 10–15 分钟轮询，抓取复用小电脑上的爬虫服务。
- **存储**：Meilisearch 或 SQLite FTS5，需配中文分词，选型前实测召回。
- **入库即验证**：入库时完成日期验证，strict 查询直接按已验证日期过滤。
- **保留期**：建议 90 天。

### 结果质量

- **转载聚类**：URL 规范化，加标题与正文 simhash，把同一篇通稿归为一簇，展示原发来源和转载数。
- **跨源融合**：用 RRF 合并各来源排序；被多个独立来源同时命中的 URL 加权。
- **来源分级**：按 T1–T5 调整排序权重，T5 降权。
- **查询扩展**：繁简转换（覆盖港台来源）、实体别名（简称与全称、股票代码），科技类话题补一个英文查询。
- **重排**：小电脑算力允许时，本地运行 bge-reranker 类模型；不允许则跳过。

**交付物**：本地索引与调度任务、首批订阅清单、聚类与融合模块、P3 评测结果。

## 海外补充通道

海外搜索只保留低成本来源，统一走代理，不追加投入。

- **[Brave Search API](https://you.com/resources/tavily-alternatives)**：独立索引，每千次 $5，每月自动赠送 $5 额度。
- **[GDELT DOC 2.0](https://apify.com/dami_studio/gdelt-news-scraper)**：公开接口，无需 key，覆盖 65+ 种语言、约最近 3 个月的新闻，单次最多 250 条。它的 `seendate` 是 GDELT 发现文章的时间，按 E4 处理。
- **现有 bing、yandex 引擎**：保留，走代理。
- **Naver**：不启用。
- **不考虑**：Bing Search API 已于 2025-08-11 下线；Google Custom Search JSON API 已不接受新用户，2027-01-01 停服（[来源](https://cloro.dev/blog/google-custom-search-api-shutdown/)）。

## 评测、监控与验收

验收以固定的 golden set 为准，各维度分开报告。下表阈值是建议初值，P0 基线测完后校准一次，然后冻结。

**Golden set**

- 约 150 条查询，中文约 70%，海外约 30%。
- 分五类：general、news、strict day、长尾、公众号与平台内容。
- 每条标注期望命中的 URL 或事实；strict 类另外标注参考发布日期。
- 另建中文日期提取标注集：约 200 个页面，覆盖最常用的 50 个域名和公众号文章。

**指标与建议阈值**

| 维度 | 指标 | 建议阈值 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 可用性 | 网关成功响应率 | ≥ 99% |
| 可用性 | p95 延迟 | general ≤ 8 s；strict ≤ 15 s |
| 供给 | 中文 general 零结果率 | ≤ 10% |
| 供给 | 中文 news 零结果率 | ≤ 15% |
| 供给 | ≥ 2 个独立来源同时出结果的查询占比 | ≥ 60% |
| 相关性 | recall@10（命中标注的期望结果） | ≥ 70% |
| 相关性 | 首条结果相关率 | ≥ 80% |
| 日期证据 | strict day 至少有 1 条 `verified` 结果的查询占比 | ≥ 80% |
| 日期证据 | 日期提取准确率（标注集） | ≥ 95% |
| 日期证据 | strict 结果中非 `verified` 的条目数 | 0 |
| 覆盖 | 公众号类查询命中率 | ≥ 60% |
| 质量 | 前 10 条中同一转载簇的条目数 | ≤ 2 |
| 成本 | 付费 API 月成本 | ≤ ¥10（WAG 内硬上限） |

**监控**

- 每个供给源单独跑 canary：每小时少量固定查询，记录成功率、验证码率、延迟的时间序列。
- 熔断与降级依据 canary 数据，而不是单次失败。
- 评测降频、错峰执行；同一出口、同一引擎设请求速率上限。
- 每条结果的诊断字段标出 `provider`、证据等级、结果状态、是否为聚类代表。

## 风险、成本与合规

主要风险是付费 API 的成本与配额、中文日期误判，以及平台反爬变化。每项都有降级路径，不会让现有能力退化。

| 风险 | 影响 | 应对 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 家宽 IP 被搜索引擎风控 | 家人正常上网受影响 | 国内引擎限速、验证码熔断与指数退避，评测计入同一限速 |
| ¥10 预算很快用完 | 当月后期召回下降 | 百度免费额度优先、日上限、加长缓存，超限降级到免费层 |
| 百度账号限 1–3 QPS | 并发查询被拒 | 本地限流队列，超限转下一个 provider |
| 日期误判（转载、侧栏日期） | strict 结果不可信 | 证据等级、噪声排除规则、标注集回归测试 |
| 页面抓取拖慢响应 | strict 查询变慢 | 只验证前 10–20 条，设并发上限与超时，按 URL 缓存 |
| 搜狗微信等平台反爬变化 | 公众号通道失效 | 主路径走腾讯云官方接口，抓取只作补充 |
| 上游 API 改名、改版或调价 | adapter 失效、成本变化 | adapter 契约测试纳入 release；每季度复核价格（腾讯云联网搜索已改名为元宝搜索） |

**成本**：付费 API 月预算硬上限 ¥10。百度只用每天 100 次的免费额度；阿里云 IQS 国内版 LiteBasic ¥8/千次；腾讯云元宝搜索极速版 ¥14/千次。分配见 P1 的预算表。

**合规**

- 三家国内 API 都需要实名认证，可开具发票。
- 抓取公共搜索引擎违反多数引擎的使用条款，这也是验证码的来源。官方 API 优先，抓取通道降为补充。
- 不做验证码自动破解。
- RSSHub 与页面抓取遵守目标站点的 robots 规则和频率限制。

**部署**

- 在小电脑上自建 RSSHub（Docker），只在内网监听，不对外暴露。
- 标「需 Chromium」的 2 条（人民银行、微博热搜）要用带浏览器的 RSSHub 镜像；不想多跑浏览器，就先删掉这 2 条。

- [ ] 抽查每个源 3 篇文章的日期提取结果，算出该源的 E1/E2 命中率。
- [ ] 抓取失败或日期命中率过低的源，在本页删除或替换。

**本次未收录**：商务部（路由参数含义不明确，待确认栏目后再加）、FT 中文网（本次无法访问核实）、光明日报与中国青年报（RSSHub 无路由，可后续用 sitemap 补）。

items.title: feat: support GPT-5 and GPT-6 reasoning effort configuration
items.body:
## What this PR does Adds model-specific reasoning effort configuration for a closed set of known GPT-5 models and GPT-6 Astra. Shared model normalization handles provider prefixes, routing tags, whitespace, numeric patch versions, and dated snapshots. Unknown family suffixes and future minor versions keep the generic provider behavior. ACP and Web Shell advertise supported tiers, thinking requirements, and default state. Astra exposes low, medium, high, xhigh, and max, defaults to medium, and has no off option. Maps configured effort to the Chat Completions `reasoning_effort` field, including on DashScope-compatible gateways serving GPT models. Unsupported tiers clamp to the known model's supported range; unrelated sampling parameters and sibling reasoning budgets survive. OpenRouter retains its nested protocol, and explicit raw request overrides retain their priority. Nullish and empty-string flat placeholders allow configured effort; raw nested values, including null, remain whole-object overrides. Mandatory-thinking cleanup removes unsupported flat none without dropping forced-tool constraints. Shared preferences survive model switches and reloads when using the built-in GPT capabilities. Explicit configured capabilities retain their tier restrictions, defaults, disable-field ownership, and persistence reconciliation. GPT capability lookup handles batch tags locally, leaving other models’ token limits and modalities unchanged. Controls report supported native flat overrides and OpenRouter nested effort values as their effective raw tier. Opaque native nested overrides show the model default. An explicit tier request blocked by a raw override fails without retaining a live change or saving a preference, even when it matches the displayed value. The thinking switch normally selects the advertised default tier, enabling models whose API default is off. With a blocking raw override, the switch restores configured defaults after off only when those defaults permit thinking. If the raw state or the session’s configured reasoning default disables thinking, the off switch is disabled and the saved preference is retained, including when configured capabilities omit a default tier or expose only a toggle. Default resolution uses the owning session or request, including after a provider entry is removed, so another workspace cannot alter this decision. ACP default always keeps its reset semantics. Welcome switch-on intent belongs to its source model and is discarded when the model changes, preserving the target’s existing preference, while an explicitly selected compatible tier still carries over. Model switching does not synthesize reset commands from saved max or none preferences. The merge preserves explicit model reasoning capabilities from main. Validated GPT tiers are translated after raw request parameters merge, so a cleared flat field cannot swallow an accepted tier and raw nested whole-object overrides retain their priority. A saved off preference survives mandatory GPT model switches even when capabilities are declared, unless the declaration explicitly forbids disabling. OpenRouter sampling flat overrides report their effective tier. Welcome rejects pending tiers that a raw override prevents changing, whether the target is off or already on, so the first prompt proceeds using the target state. ## Why it's needed GPT models currently expose generic effort choices and defaults that do not match their capabilities. Requests send the internal nested reasoning object instead of the Chat Completions field, while configuring sampling parameters can drop effort entirely. A selected effort can therefore be ignored or rejected. ## Reviewer Test Plan ### How to verify 1. Configure GPT-5.4 with high effort and a completion-token sampling budget. Confirm the request carries flat high effort alongside the budget, without an injected nested reasoning object. 2. Set the shared effort preference to max for GPT-5.1, GPT-5.4, GPT-5.6, and GPT-6 Astra. Confirm their outgoing efforts are high, xhigh, max, and max, respectively. Confirm explicit raw effort overrides retain their priority, except unsupported flat none on mandatory-thinking models. 3. Inspect ACP reasoning controls when switching models. Confirm GPT-5.4 defaults to thinking off, GPT-5.5 defaults to medium, and GPT-6 Astra starts at medium with all five tiers. Astra and other mandatory-thinking models must reject off. Unsupported new picker selections should be rejected. Save max, switch from GPT-5.6 Sol to GPT-5.4 and back, and verify that the original preference survives while the active tier clamps to xhigh and returns to max. Likewise, a saved off preference should survive a temporary switch to Astra. 4. Turn thinking on in Web Shell for a default-off GPT-5.4 session. Confirm it selects medium and enables the effort picker. Turn it off again and confirm the request sends none; OpenRouter must instead retain its nested disable field. Verify raw flat overrides and nullish/empty flat placeholders preserve their documented precedence. 5. Verify GPT high/max and sampling budgets through a DashScope-compatible gateway. Forced-tool requests must retain required selection on GPT Pro/Astra unless an explicit provider restriction applies. Confirm existing Qwen controls and generic provider behavior remain consistent with the baseline. 6. Check unknown GPT suffixes/future versions keep generic controls, while provider-prefixed known Sol/Astra models get their model capabilities. With Astra on a native endpoint and a raw flat none override in either layer, confirm the control shows medium and rejects xhigh. With native-endpoint raw nested reasoning, including null, confirm the raw value remains unchanged and blocked tier changes reject, even when selecting the displayed default. 7. With native flat overrides or OpenRouter nested effort, enabled, and token-budget overrides, verify blocked tier changes reject and settings stay unchanged. Turn an opaque GPT-5.5 configuration off and back on: its raw default must be restored when that default permits thinking; selecting a tier must still reject. With raw flat none, OpenRouter nested disable, or a configured reasoning default of false combined with a blocking raw override, the ON action must be disabled, send no configuration request when clicked, and retain saved preferences in both user and workspace settings, including configured tiers without a default and toggle-only controls. An explicit default command must still reset the preference. On Welcome, turn Qwen thinking on, switch to GPT-5.4, and submit: the target keeps its existing preference without persisting Qwen’s xhigh or clearing a saved off preference. An explicit xhigh selection remains transferable. 8. Declare a GPT model’s reasoning capabilities explicitly. Verify its permitted tier list and native disable field are preserved. Null/empty flat fields still allow selected effort, raw nested overrides still own their object, and a non-GPT batch route keeps its original output limits and modalities. 9. On Welcome, explicitly select xhigh on another model, then select a target whose raw parameters fix its effort. Check both an off/cannot-enable target and an already-on High target: the preview must retain the target state and the first prompt must send without a rejected tier write. A compatible target without a raw restriction should still carry xhigh. 10. Start a cold Welcome workspace with a saved off preference and a provider raw reasoning override. If the raw default permits thinking, turning ON should use the accepted default reset and the first message should receive a reply. If raw settings prevent enabling, ON should remain disabled and the first message should still succeed without changing the saved preference. A provider with empty generation settings must keep ordinary controls even when top-level settings contain a raw disable. ### Evidence (Before & After) The baseline used globally installed Qwen Code 0.23.0; verification used the local bundle with a recording mock endpoint and active ACP sessions. | Scenario | Before | After | | --- | --- | --- | | GPT-5.4 high effort | Nested reasoning object | Flat high effort | | High effort with sampling token budget | Effort omitted | Effort and budget both present | | Shared max preference on GPT-5.1 / 5.4 / 5.6 | Nested xhigh for all three | Flat high / xhigh / max | | GPT-5.4 thinking off | Reasoning field omitted | Flat none | | GPT reasoning controls | Generic tiers and default | Model-specific tiers, defaults, and mandatory-thinking constraints | **Web Shell controls (GPT-5.6 Sol and GPT-6 Astra).** Chromium screenshots of the current Web Shell replaying unchanged reasoning options recorded from active PR ACP sessions through the repository's mock daemon. Both models start at Medium; the screenshots show Max selected. GPT-5.6 Sol allows thinking to be toggled, while GPT-6 Astra keeps it enabled and locks the switch. Playwright verified all five tiers, the initial Medium value, both thinking-switch states, and the persisted Max selection requests. | GPT-5.6 Sol — Max selected | GPT-6 Astra — Max selected | | :---: | :---: | | | | **Request fields (Before & After).** Comparisons generated from new recording-mock-endpoint runs for these exact two model identifiers. Each covers High, Max, and High with a 1024 completion-token budget. All six current-bundle request scenarios and both ACP capture scenarios passed; the global Qwen Code 0.23.0 baseline reproduced the nested-field, max-clamping, and sampling-effort-loss problems. Only relevant request fields are shown; real provider verification is reported separately below. ![GPT-5.6 Sol request comparison: flat high and max effort, with the sampling token budget preserved](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/b5131b45ad0d560198f6a2c6a970d3eb3ff96ec7/pr11295/gpt-5.6-sol-request-comparison.png) ![GPT-6 Astra request comparison: flat high and max effort, with the sampling token budget preserved](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/b5131b45ad0d560198f6a2c6a970d3eb3ff96ec7/pr11295/gpt-6-astra-request-comparison.png) **Earlier review verification (R2).** Passed **3,313 unit tests** (648 core, 1,746 CLI, 919 Web Shell), full build, bundle, workspace/integration typecheck, and changed-file lint/formatting. Eight deliberate mutation categories failed the expected regression assertions when protections were removed; original model, wire, ACP and UI regressions were also observed before the fixes. The rebuilt CLI passed 90 request/ACP E2E scenarios (51 wire and 39 ACP), 2 Chromium replay scenarios, and 13 no-network checks; 200 local mock API calls were recorded, including one fixture-only rerun. After the audit findings were fixed, two consecutive full-diff self-audits and the final independent reverse review found no further issue. [R2 verification report](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/11295#issuecomment-5577704626). Prior verification remains available in the [earlier follow-up report](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/11295#issuecomment-5574522801). **Cold Welcome follow-up (current, `9355b21d`).** Cold reasoning previews now preserve saved off preferences while advertising the accepted default reset or disabling an unavailable ON action. Passed 806 related unit tests, 4 real daemon/Chromium workflows and 2 direct ACP workflows, each receiving the first reply. Full build/bundle, full typecheck, changed-file lint/formatting and two consecutive self-audit and independent audit passes completed before commit. Only inference was mocked on loopback; there were no new external model calls. [Reproduction, verification and current CI status](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/11295#issuecomment-5598716671). **Historical R6 review verification (`9c48225e`).** Fixed saved-off preference loss, OpenRouter raw-tier reporting, and Welcome first-prompt failures, including a raw-on combination found in pre-commit reverse audit. Passed 2,937 unit tests, 27 built CLI ACP scenarios / 200 assertions, 3 final built-WebShell scenarios, 4 Welcome browser cases and all 58 Chromium smoke cases on the first attempt. Full build/bundle, full typecheck, repository lint/formatting and two consecutive root and independent clean audits passed before commit. [R6 verification, deferred inventory and CI status](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/11295#issuecomment-5596464906). **Historical R5 CI and main integration verification.** Merged the current main gate and its slow-rendering history-anchor fix, then corrected three obsolete mock references exposed by integration. Passed full build/bundle, full typecheck, repository lint/formatting, 3,441 focused unit tests and 9 lint-gate tests. All 58 Chromium smoke cases passed on their first attempt, including the 4× CPU throttled case that reproduced the original 286px failure. The existing GPT effort matrix also passed: 27 ACP scenarios / 560 assertions and 9 built-WebShell scenarios, with two consecutive clean self-audits and independent review passes. [R5 verification and CI status](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/11295#issuecomment-5593004585). **Historical R4 switch correction verification.** Unavailable ON actions are now disabled and retain both settings scopes; legitimate raw-on restoration and explicit default reset remain supported. Verification passed 1,808 unit tests, 27 actual ACP scenarios with 560 assertions, and 9 built-WebShell browser scenarios with 129 local mock requests. Full build/bundle, final CLI build, full typecheck, lint and formatting passed. Two consecutive reverse self-audits and independent review found no remaining actionable issue. [R4 verification report and limits](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/11295#issuecomment-5590214980). **Historical R3 review and conflict verification.** Merged main while preserving configured model capabilities, addressed all 12 review threads, and fixed the additional Welcome preference issues found in reverse audit. Build, bundle, full typecheck, lint, formatting, and 3,392 focused unit tests pass. The core/CLI matrix passed 41 ACP cases, 18 headless wire cases and 32 no-network checks; the final bundle additionally passed 9 ACP cases, 6 key browser scenarios and the full 53-test smoke suite without automatic retries. Two consecutive root and independent audit passes found no remaining issue. The first final smoke run exposed an old test that required the implicit preference reset being removed; its corrected contract was independently reviewed before the full passing rerun. [Full R3 verification and limitations](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/11295#issuecomment-5585060384). **Real provider verification (historical, before R2 review fixes).** GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.6 Sol each passed five scenarios using their existing settings. GPT-6 Astra passed the same five scenarios after the extension; the earlier GPT-5-only bundle reproduced nested high, max reduced to xhigh, and effort omitted with a sampling budget. All successful primary replies were exactly `42` with no tool calls. The following table records actual outgoing fields: | Scenario | GPT-5.5 | GPT-5.6 Sol | GPT-6 Astra | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Original configuration | Effort omitted | Effort omitted | Effort omitted | | High | Flat high | Flat high | Flat high | | Shared max preference | Flat xhigh | Flat max | Flat max | | Attempted off | Flat none | Flat none | No invalid off value; mandatory thinking retained | | High + 1024 completion budget | Flat high + budget | Flat high + budget | Flat high + budget | A follow-up Astra run also passed low, medium, and xhigh, completing live coverage of all five tiers. Each tier was transmitted unchanged in flat `reasoning_effort` and accepted by the configured gateway. The CLI log does not retain independently usable reasoning-token counts, so these results do not establish differences in internal computation. Across the successful GPT-5 and post-fix GPT-6 tests, 18 primary requests and 20 automatic-memory background requests completed. GPT-5.4 could not complete live verification: its configured route returned HTTP 502 with `unknown provider for model gpt-5.4`, and it was absent from the authenticated model list. The max case was aborted; off and budget cases were skipped. This is reported as blocked, not passed. ### Tested on | OS | Status | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ✅ tested | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested | | 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested | ### Environment (optional) Node.js 22.22.2 on macOS, using the bundled CLI and isolated configuration/runtime directories. Mock tests use loopback endpoints and mock credentials; live tests use the selected models' existing provider settings and credentials without changing the original settings. ## Risk & Scope - Main risk or tradeoff: new model identifiers require explicit capability review; unknown variants retain generic behavior rather than inferred mandatory-thinking rules. Raw gateway parameters can produce a different effective effort from the requested preference. Native nested raw parameters remain opaque, and CLI/SDK override reporting has not been generalized. - Not validated / out of scope: GPT-5.4 live inference is blocked by the configured gateway's missing route. Live tests establish outgoing fields and gateway acceptance, not internal reasoning depth or quality differences. Live daemon-to-Web Shell integration was not tested; the screenshots use replayed ACP fixtures. This does not add a Responses transport. Astra's official tool-calling API requires Responses; the configured Chat Completions gateway is responsible for that compatibility, and live tool calling was not tested. - Breaking changes / migration notes: No configuration migration is required. Existing effort preferences are adapted to the active model. ## Linked Issues None; requested directly.
中文说明 ## 本 PR 的改动 为已知的 GPT-5 模型和 GPT-6 Astra 增加模型专属推理 effort 配置。能力清单明确列举型号，共享规范化逻辑处理 provider 前缀、路由标签、空白、数字补丁版本和日期快照；未知后缀及未来 minor 版本保留通用 provider 行为。ACP 和 Web Shell 展示支持的档位、思考要求及默认状态。Astra 提供 low、medium、high、xhigh、max 五档，默认 medium，不提供关闭选项。 将配置的 effort 映射为 Chat Completions 的 `reasoning_effort` 字段，包括通过 DashScope 兼容网关访问 GPT 的路径。不支持的档位会适配到已知模型范围，同时保留其他采样参数和 reasoning 预算。OpenRouter 保留嵌套协议，显式原始请求参数保持覆盖优先级。平铺字段的空值和空字符串允许配置档位生效；嵌套原始值（包括 null）保留整对象覆盖语义。强制思考清理会移除不支持的平铺 none，且不会移除强制工具约束。使用内置 GPT 能力时，共享偏好在切换模型和重载后保留；显式配置的模型能力仍决定档位限制、默认值、关闭字段和偏好清理规则。batch 标签仅在 GPT 能力查询中处理，其他模型的 token 限制和模态保持原有行为。 控件将原生端点的已知平铺覆盖档位，以及 OpenRouter 的已知嵌套 effort 显示为实际原始档位；原生端点的不透明嵌套覆盖显示模型默认值。被原始覆盖阻断的显式选档会失败，不保留运行时改动、不保存偏好，即使所选值恰好等于当前显示值。思考开关通常选择已声明的默认档位，让 API 默认关闭的模型能够开启；存在阻断覆盖时，只有默认值允许思考，开关才会在关闭后恢复默认配置。若原始参数或该会话配置的默认值关闭思考，关闭状态的开关会被禁用并保留已保存的偏好，包括省略默认档位或仅提供开关的能力配置。默认值始终来自所属会话或请求，即使 provider 配置项被删除，也不会受其他工作区影响。ACP default 始终保留重置语义。欢迎页开启意图绑定来源模型，换模型时丢弃该待提交意图并保留目标已有偏好；用户明确选择的兼容档位仍可沿用。模型切换不会把已保存的 max 或 none 偏好转换成重置命令。 合并保留了 main 的显式模型推理能力。GPT 档位通过能力验证后，在原始请求参数合并完成后再转换，避免空平铺字段吞掉已确认的档位，并保留原始嵌套参数的整对象覆盖优先级。 已保存的关闭偏好在切换到声明了能力的强制思考 GPT 模型时也会保留，除非该声明显式禁止关闭。OpenRouter 的采样层平铺覆盖会显示实际档位。欢迎页会丢弃被原始参数阻断的待提交档位，无论目标当前关闭还是已开启，首条消息都按目标现有状态继续发送。 ## 为什么需要 GPT 模型当前展示的通用 effort 档位和默认值与模型能力不符。请求发送的是内部嵌套 reasoning 对象，而不是 Chat Completions 要求的字段；配置采样参数还可能让 effort 完全丢失。因此，用户选择的 effort 可能被忽略或拒绝。 ## 审阅者测试计划 ### 如何验证 1. 为 GPT-5.4 配置 high effort 和 completion-token 采样预算。确认请求同时包含平铺的 high effort 和预算，且没有自动注入的嵌套 reasoning 对象。 2. 分别为 GPT-5.1、GPT-5.4、GPT-5.6 和 GPT-6 Astra 设置统一 max 偏好。确认实际 effort 分别为 high、xhigh、max 和 max；显式原始 effort 覆盖参数保留优先级，但强制思考模型不接受平铺的 none。 3. 切换模型并检查 ACP 推理控件。确认 GPT-5.4 默认关闭思考，GPT-5.5 默认 medium，GPT-6 Astra 初始选中 medium 并提供全部五档。Astra 和其他强制思考模型必须拒绝关闭；新选择的不支持档位应被拒绝。保存 max，从 GPT-5.6 Sol 切换到 GPT-5.4 再切回，确认原始偏好保留，而当前档位先适配为 xhigh、再恢复为 max。同样，已保存的关闭偏好应在临时切换到 Astra 后保留。 4. 在默认关闭的 GPT-5.4 Web Shell 会话中开启思考，确认选中 medium 且档位按钮可用。再次关闭时，请求应发送 none；OpenRouter 则使用嵌套关闭字段。确认原始平铺覆盖参数、空值及空字符串占位符合已说明的优先级。 5. 通过 DashScope 兼容网关验证 GPT high/max 与采样预算。除非存在显式 provider 限制，GPT Pro/Astra 的强制工具请求必须保留 required 选择。确认现有 Qwen 控件和通用 7. 使用原生平铺覆盖，以及 OpenRouter 嵌套 effort、enabled 和 token 预算覆盖，确认被阻断的选档报错且设置不变。将带不透明覆盖的 GPT-5.5 先关闭再开启，默认值允许思考时应恢复原始配置，但显式选档仍被拒绝。原始平铺 none、OpenRouter 嵌套关闭参数，或同时存在阻断的原始覆盖与 reasoning 为 false 的配置默认值时，关闭状态的开关应禁用，点击不应发送配置请求，用户和工作区两层偏好应保留；明确发送 default 命令仍应重置偏好。欢迎页开启 Qwen 思考后切到 GPT-5.4 并发送，应保留目标已有偏好，不把 Qwen 的 xhigh 保存过去，也不清除已保存的关闭偏好；明确选择 xhigh 的对照场景仍可沿用。 8. 显式声明 GPT 模型的推理能力，确认允许的档位和原生关闭字段被保留。平铺空值仍允许所选档位生效，原始嵌套覆盖仍拥有整对象优先级，非 GPT batch 路由保留原来的输出限制和模态。 9. 在欢迎页明确选择其他模型的 xhigh 后，切换到由原始参数固定档位的目标。分别检查关闭且不可开启、以及已开启 High 的目标：预览应保留目标状态，首条消息不应因无效选档失败；没有原始限制的兼容目标仍可沿用 xhigh。 reasoning token 计数，因此这些结果不证明内部计算量的差异。成功的 GPT-5 和修复后 GPT-6 测试共完成 18 个主请求及 20 个自动记忆后台请求。 GPT-5.4 未能完成真实验证：配置的路由返回 HTTP 502 和 `unknown provider for model gpt-5.4`，经过认证的模型列表也没有该模型。max 场景已中止，关闭及预算场景已跳过。该结果记录为受阻，未记为通过。 ### 测试平台 | 操作系统 | 状态 | | :---: | :---: | | 🍏 macOS | ✅ 已测试 | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 | | 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未测试 | ### 环境 macOS、Node.js 22.22.2；使用打包后的 CLI 和隔离的配置及运行目录。模拟测试使用回环端点和模拟凭据；真实测试使用所选模型已有的 provider 配置和凭据，未修改原始设置。 ## 风险与范围 - 主要风险或权衡：新增型号需要明确复核能力；未知变体保持通用行为，不推断强制思考规则。原始网关参数可能使实际 effort 与请求偏好不同；原生端点的嵌套原始参数保留透传，CLI/SDK 的覆盖参数报告未作通用化扩展。 - 未验证或不在范围内：GPT-5.4 真实推理受配置网关缺少路由阻塞。真实测试确认请求字段和网关接受情况，不证明内部推理深度或质量差异。未进行实际 daemon 与 Web Shell 的联调；截图使用 ACP 记录回放。本改动不增加 Responses 传输。Astra 官方工具调用 API 要求 Responses；当前 Chat Completions 网关负责兼容，未测试真实工具调用。 - 破坏性改动或迁移说明：无需配置迁移，已有 effort 偏好会适配到当前模型。 ## 关联 Issue 无；由用户直接提出。
